special.name: FOCUS SHOT
special.text: Half-second charge ring, then a thick beam fires straight up for 1 second. It pierces every enemy in the line. Strong against bosses.
special.short: Charged beam that pierces every enemy in a line.

special.name: SHIELD BURST
special.text: A round shockwave grows from the jet. Every enemy bullet it touches turns into gold sparks, and enemies inside freeze for 1 second.
special.short: Shockwave that wipes out nearby enemy bullets.

special_rules.trigger: Shift (keyboard) or X (gamepad). Press when the bar is full. Using it empties the bar.
special_rules.bar_fill: Fills as you shoot and destroy enemies. About 40 seconds of normal play to fill.
special_rules.shop_modifier: Shop 'Special Charge' makes it fill faster (see shop.json).

a2_burst.name: A2 BURST
a2_burst.how: With the A2 meter full, both pilots press Special within 1 second.
a2_burst.effect: Both beams twist into one giant beam for 2 seconds, clearing all bullets and hitting everything on screen. Bosses lose 15% of their health.
a2_burst.meter: Fills when both pilots shoot. Needs both pilots alive.
